{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Identify refunded orders
refunded = sales[sales['status'] == 'refunded']

# Filter for completed orders only
completed = sales[sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Remove QA orders from completed orders
completed_filtered = completed[~completed['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders (after filtering out QA and refunded)
mean_revenue = completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print key numbers for evidence
print("Number of QA orders:", len(qa_orders))
print("Number of refunded orders:", len(refunded))
print("Number of completed orders:", len(completed))
print("Number of completed orders after removing QA:", len(completed_filtered))
print("Mean revenue of completed orders (filtered):", mean_revenue)"}
